div.div:
aroma-pacifico-terraform-modules (Public)
• Reusable modules tagged vX.Y.Z; no credentials/state
• Verified by tflint, validate, and checkov
aroma-pacifico-infrastructure (Private)
• Root stacks per env; consumes modules by tag; plan-only
• Remote state isolated per environment account
aroma-pacifico-platform (Private, ASM-170)
• Workload functions, schemas, and prompts
• Single byte-identical Release Candidate build

div.div:
Deterministic Artifact Pinning (ASM-171)
• Built once per release tag by publisher role
• Lambda zip packages and container images
• SHA-256 digests pinned in releases.tfvars
Single Release Candidate Promotion
• Exactly one RC promoted across dev, qa, pdn
• Staged in regional S3 artifact bucket per environment
• Zero environment-specific artifact rebuilds
Traceability
• Traceable to commit SHA, roadmap issue, and PR approvals

Environment & Target
• Dedicated sandbox account and isolated VPC
• Continuous integration on PR merge to main
CI Plan Gates [D11] & Evidence [D13]
• Automated terraform plan in CI (sec 4.2)
• Validation: fmt, validate, tflint, checkov (D13, PD-019)
• Plan attached with destroys and replacements first
Execution & Testing
• Automated terraform apply on merge via OIDC
• Function deployment via LambdaAllAtOnce (ASM-174)
• Smoke tests generate promotion evidence

Environment & Target
• Pattern environment topology (D04, D05, D08)
• Synthetic telemetry & test flight objects
Promotion & Verification Gates [D12]
• Gate 1: Dev verification log and test evidence
• Gate 2: 1 peer review (SR1/SR2/JR1/JR2 not author, ASM-172)
• Gate 3: Fresh terraform plan review against QA pattern
Execution & Testing
• Automated terraform apply on PR merge via OIDC
• CodeDeploy canary: LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes (ASM-174)
• Acceptance suite recorded in deployment (ASM-177)

div.div:
Environment & Target
• Primary production workload (AWS us-east-1)
• Live coffee data (Cauca, Huila, Tolima)
Four Mandatory Production Gates [D12]
1. Approver: One of SR1 or SR2 (not author/trigger, ASM-172)
2. Notice: 2 business days lead time to Federation (ASM-173)
3. Window: 05:00-18:00 Colombia blocked; no run if end > 05:00 (ASM-007, ASM-178)
4. Plan: Fresh plan review, QA acceptance passed (sec 4.4)
Deployment & Safeguards
• Automated apply via GitHub OIDC apply role
• CodeDeploy canary: LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes (ASM-174)
• CloudWatch rollback alarms armed (ASM-229)

div.div:
OIDC IAM Identities [D06]
• Short-lived credentials via plan (read-only) and apply roles
• BreakGlass via IAM Identity Center only; never in CI/CD
Remote State Isolation [D02]
• Dedicated S3 state bucket per account with native locking (ADR-003)
• KMS CMK encryption under state key class (ASM-097)
Configuration & Secrets [D03]
• Secrets Manager and SSM Parameter Store; dynamic runtime resolution
• Zero static credentials or secrets in git or state

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 558px; height: 1px; padding-top: 752px; margin-left: 688px;

div.div:
Deployment Engine & Strategy (ASM-174)
• AWS CodeDeploy application and deployment groups
• dev: CodeDeployDefault.LambdaAllAtOnce
• qa & pdn: CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes
Traffic Shifting & Validation
• Routes 10% traffic to new alias version for 5 minutes
• Auto-rollback triggered if any rollback alarm fires
• Shifts remaining 90% on green bake; keeps 5 versions
Workload Functions (ASM-160, ASM-161, ASM-170)
• Threshold function [D10], reception function, Bedrock inference [D10]

div.div: Observability & Rollback Hooks (ASM-174, ASM-229)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 558px; height: 1px; padding-top: 752px; margin-left: 1318px;

div.div:
CloudWatch Rollback Alarms Set (ASM-229)
• 1-minute period: errors ≥ 1, throttles ≥ 1, DLQ > 0, API 5XX > 5%
• Evaluated per function alias; pdn job starts only if all OK
Rollback Design Targets (ASM-174, PD-176)
• Automatic CodeDeploy rollback: Traffic to prior version < 10 min
• Rollback deployment: Move alias to prior version < 30 min
• Revert commit through promotion: Plan & apply < 2 hours
Failure Recovery & Redrive (sec 10)
• Operator DLQ redrive after fix; deployment events to SNS

div.div: Harvest Window & Incident Policy (ASM-007, ASM-178, ASM-183)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 598px; height: 1px; padding-top: 752px; margin-left: 1948px;

div.div:
Harvest Window Policy (ASM-007, ASM-178)
• Blocked 05:00-18:00 Colombia time on harvest-week days (ASM-007)
• Job refuses to start if expected end passes 05:00 (ASM-178)
• Covers whole pdn job including canary shifts (sec 4.4)
• Federation notice: default 2 business days lead time (ASM-173, Q-15)
Emergency Incident Exception (ASM-183)
• Change inside window requires incident reference (INC-YYYYMMDD-NN)
• Declared by SR1 or SR2 to fix critical harm; never for features
• Shortened notice at decision; note completed in 1 business day
Forward Correction (ASM-175, ASM-185)
• Fixes roll forward via Git; additive backward-compatible schemas
